description: External ground truth. MCP/OAuth auth advisories filed by OTHER researchers, pinned at the pre-fix commit. A CATCH = the scanner fires the expected rule (or, for class-level entries, any detector) AT the advisory's root-cause file. Deliberately NOT seeded from VATA findings - it measures whether detectors generalize. Misses are the roadmap. Verified pre-fix SHAs as of 2026-10-05.

advisories.class_note: issuer validation skipped in a 404 fallback path in discovery - logic/dataflow bug, not a missing-issuer= construction
PKCE bypass via downgrade; B1 only matches skipLocalPkceValidation:true or verifier-without-S256
FastMCP(auth=_auth) where _auth stays None when oauth_enabled is false (default) - auth disabled by default, VATA class A; no rule yet, only A4 SSRF noise fires
